name: District 10
description: The venue is a charming old schoolhouse converted into a unique karaoke spot that offers a cozy and nostalgic atmosphere. It features a friendly host named Mary who creates a welcoming environment. The venue is known for its excellent popcorn, great drinks, and a vibe that combines a small-town feel with a fun, community-oriented spirit. It is perfect for those seeking a relaxed yet lively karaoke experience in a distinctive setting.
